questions.stem_text: Country A has a current account surplus; this means that

options.A: Country A also has a financial account surplus.
options.B: Country A has a financial account deficit.
options.C: Country A must borrow from its foreign reserves.
options.D: Country A is operating in a recessionary gap.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - Country A has a financial account deficit.

questions.stem_text:
If a firm decreases its prices by 15 percent and its total revenue increases by 30
percent, which of the following is correct?

options.A: The price elasticity of demand is unit elastic.
options.B: The price elasticity of demand is inelastic.
options.C: The price elasticity of demand is elastic.
options.D: The numerical coefficient of elasticity is equal to one.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - The price elasticity of demand is elastic.

questions.stem_text: Which of the following will shift the demand curve for the Mexican peso to the left?

options.A: Speculation that the peso will increase in value
options.B: An increase in interest rates in Mexico relative to other countries
options.C: A lower rate of inflation in Mexico relative to other countries
options.D: A decrease in the international demand for Mexican-made textiles

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - A decrease in the international demand for Mexican-made textiles

questions.stem_text:
Suppose the reserve ratio is 0.1. If a bank gets $200 in deposits what is the maximum
amount it can lend?
The Law of Diminishing Marginal Returns is responsible for

options.A: AVC that first rises, but eventually falls, as output increases.
options.B: AFC that first rises, but eventually falls, as output increases.
options.C: MP that first falls, but eventually rises, as output increases.
options.D: MC that first falls, but eventually rises, as output increases.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - MC that first falls, but eventually rises, as output increases.
